profile.name: Joshua Ibrahim
profile.title: Full Stack Software Developer & Systems Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Developer specializing in modern web development with expertise in React.js, PHP, Golang, and WordPress (REST API integrations, custom plugins, and themes). Skilled in building high-performance, scalable applications and optimizing backend systems. Strong background in full-cycle development—from architecture and design to deployment and maintenance. Passionate about clean code, efficient workflows, and leveraging the right tools to deliver impactful solutions.

highlights: Designed and implemented a ticketing system to streamline IT support requests and improve issue resolution efficiency.
Built a digital solution to manage patient queues, reducing wait times and improving operational workflow.
Designing interfaces and developing the frontend for hospital management software, while integrating APIs and optimizing user workflows.
Assisted in configuring, maintaining, and optimizing the hospital's network infrastructure for reliability and security.
Provided technical troubleshooting, hardware/software maintenance, and user assistance for hospital staff.
Spearheaded development of the company website (COLLETT Foundation) and client project (PGF website).
Managed complete IT infrastructure including systems, networks, and technical operations.
Led all technology projects from conception to deployment.
Conducted professional training programs in: Web Development, Digital Marketing and Computer Networking.
Oversaw cross-functional technology initiatives and team collaboration.

projects.title: HMIS – Health Management Information System
projects.shortDescription: Modern hospital operating platform with patient queue management, electronic medical workflows, and resilient microservices.
projects.longDescription: A mission-critical enterprise health management system combining high-throughput Go backend services with an accessible, high-performance Next.js 16 frontend. Solves complex patient flow, queue bottlenecks, appointment routing, and secure audit logging.
highlights: Built frontend with Next.js 16 & React 19 in TypeScript using Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, and Base UI.
Engineered Go Fiber backend with PostgreSQL (pgx v5) and schema migrations.
Implemented Redis caching, 2FA/TOTP authentication, and transactional email pipelines.
Integrated interactive analytics dashboards with Recharts and dark/light mode.

projects.title: Helpdesk Enterprise Asset & SLA Tracker
projects.shortDescription: Web & mobile enterprise platform for hardware inventory, offline field audits, and automated support ticket lifecycle.
projects.longDescription: Cross-platform enterprise solution for hardware inventory tracking, maintenance logging, and support request management built with Next.js 15, React Native Expo, and Supabase. Features offline-first SQLite sync and biometric security.
highlights: Engineered offline-first mobile sync architecture using Expo SQLite for zero-connectivity field audits.
Biometric authentication (Fingerprint/FaceID) for secure hardware data access.
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) hierarchy for Super Admins, Field Agents, and Property Managers.
Automated barcode scanning/generation and interactive SLA analytics.

projects.title: Ticket Spring Event & Ticketing Platform
projects.shortDescription: High-performance event management system featuring dynamic PDF ticket generation, QR validation, and Flutterwave payments.
projects.longDescription: Complete event registration and ticketing powerhouse. Handles automated ticket rendering with dynamic barcodes/QR codes, split payment payouts, event voting engines, and instant multi-channel ticket delivery via Resend.
highlights: Dynamic PDF ticket generation via PDFKit with encrypted QR codes for gate check-ins.
End-to-end payment processing with Flutterwave API and automated commission payouts.
Custom voting module with automated organizer balance withdrawals.
Secure RBAC authentication with Next-Auth and PostgreSQL.

projects.title: DripLynk SaaS E-Commerce Platform
projects.shortDescription: Multi-tenant e-commerce marketplace with virtual try-on engine, seller portals, and automated CI/CD.
projects.longDescription: Spearheaded front-end development for a scalable SaaS fashion platform. Built interactive consumer, admin, and merchant portals, integrated virtual try-on APIs, and configured GitHub Actions CI/CD to Vercel.
highlights: Translated high-fidelity Figma designs into pixel-perfect modular React components.
Engineered interactive UI for virtual try-on clothing and accessories.
Automated continuous integration and deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions to Vercel.
Seamless RESTful API integration for checkout, cart, and authentication.

projects.title: Brilliantwave Online Publishing
projects.shortDescription: Global news and lifestyle platform engineered for cross-continental high-traffic performance.
projects.longDescription: High-availability multi-category publication delivering investigative reporting and multimedia stories to readers across the UK and Nigeria.
highlights: High-performance caching and responsive editorial layouts.
Integrated custom WordPress REST API for dynamic article syndication.

projects.title: TheBujDaily Regional Magazine & Ticketing
projects.shortDescription: City culture publication featuring interactive music charts, event ticketing, and local personality spotlights.
projects.longDescription: Custom media and community platform featuring local event ticketing, interactive music top charts, and profile directory.
highlights: Integrated ticket booking engine directly within editorial lifestyle content.
Interactive music countdown leaderboard with audio snippets.
